package_profile.history_policy: Historical reports, receipts, dev/post ledgers and prior release evidence are intentionally excluded from this source package.

architecture_convergence.compatibility_rule: Legacy diagnosis and source-specific routes may execute only behind canonical Runtime/API/CLI compatibility adapters.
architecture_convergence.extension_rule: DOR/FEC/ISGN/M2N are optional providers and do not own core Runtime contracts or policy.
architecture_convergence.qualification_boundary: Architecture convergence does not change G0/G1/G2/G3/G4 qualification status or establish flight/safety claims.

whole_spacecraft_online_dag.extension_semantics: Optional nodes return SKIPPED when not configured; the main diagnosis DAG remains executable without external DOR/FEC/ISGN/M2N runtimes.
whole_spacecraft_online_dag.m2n_boundary: M2N remains an offline MODEL_CHALLENGER and must cross ModelContract before promotion; it is not an online diagnosis dependency.

fusion.compatibility: legacy public fusion functions retained as facades

knowledge.workflow_boundary: backend lifecycle, release hash verification and fallback owned by service

reasoning.agent_boundary: Agent classes retained as compatibility facades

evidence.legacy_boundary: legacy.whole_spacecraft.v4 is late-loaded only through astrograph.compat.evidence

decision_release.core_comparison: CoreComparisonReference is not an independent SafetyReplayReference

core_service_extraction.parallelism_boundary: post5 stopped before typed Stage Artifacts or independent Stage replay; post6 supersedes this limitation without claiming concurrent DAG execution.

identity.semantic_sha256: non-semantic clock fields removed for replay-equivalence comparison
identity.lineage: producer stage/version, execution scope and declared upstream artifact SHA-256 values

typed_stage_artifacts.replay: AstroGraphRuntime.replay_stage executes exactly one Stage from declared upstream RuntimeStageArtifacts and fails closed on missing/extra/cross-request inputs.
typed_stage_artifacts.persistence: online persistence writes a runtime Stage Artifact index and first-18-stage artifact files; the terminal persist artifact remains in the in-memory Runtime receipt.
typed_stage_artifacts.compatibility: whole_spacecraft.online.v1 and all 19 public Stage IDs are unchanged; direct workflow invocation uses the same per-stage executor.
typed_stage_artifacts.concurrency_boundary: post7 supersedes the post6 scheduling limitation with explicit execution profiles and a bounded scheduler, but Stable whole-spacecraft execution remains serial by default until hard-cancel/provider-isolation qualification is available.
typed_stage_artifacts.qualification_boundary: Typed artifacts and replayability do not change G0/G1/G2/G3/G4 status or establish diagnostic accuracy, flight, causal or safety qualification.

safe_dag_scheduling.scheduler: bounded topological-level scheduler with resource-unit admission
safe_dag_scheduling.stable_default: SERIAL by default; post8 permits explicit SAFE_PARALLEL admission only for stages with machine-checkable hard-cancel qualification and a frozen isolated-worker adapter.
safe_dag_scheduling.cooperative_research_parallelism: Still supported for explicitly opted-in custom/non-reconstructable workflows; reviewed project-root execution uses hard-isolated parallel boundaries for the three qualified deterministic branches.
safe_dag_scheduling.transaction_boundary: online artifact persistence uses a sibling staging directory and directory-swap commit with restore-on-failure
safe_dag_scheduling.failure_propagation: parallel sibling failure cancels the shared request token and cooperative siblings exit fail-closed
safe_dag_scheduling.qualification_boundary: post8 supersedes the post7 hard-cancel blocker for exactly three local deterministic branches. KG, Data-driven, Reasoning/LLM and DOR/FEC/ISGN providers remain unqualified for isolated/provider-enforced parallelism.

isolated_provider_execution.adapter_registry: code-frozen allow-list in astrograph.runtime.isolated_worker; request metadata cannot choose adapters
isolated_provider_execution.hard_cancel: parent-enforced worker terminate followed by kill after bounded grace; no cooperation from stage code required
isolated_provider_execution.crash_containment: worker non-zero exit/no-response/invalid-response fails closed without crashing the parent Runtime
isolated_provider_execution.resource_cleanup: normal temporary workdir cleanup plus stale dead-parent workdir recovery on subsequent isolated execution
isolated_provider_execution.stable_default: SERIAL; hard-isolated SAFE_PARALLEL is explicit, bounded and qualification-gated
isolated_provider_execution.platform_boundary: Protocol avoids fork/pickled Stage closures and reconstructs workers from JSON plus project_root. Hard-cancel qualification covers the isolated worker process boundary; arbitrary provider descendant-process trees still require provider-specific enforced cleanup certification.
isolated_provider_execution.qualification_boundary: No production speedup, arbitrary-provider process safety, diagnostic-accuracy, flight/safety, or G0-G4 promotion is claimed.

provider_qualification.scheduler_rule: Stage hard-cancel/replay claims are insufficient when any bound provider lifecycle profile is not Stable-parallel eligible.
provider_qualification.external_cli_boundary: DOR/FEC/ISGN/M2N optional CLI calls use managed process groups/process trees with bounded timeout cleanup; POSIX tree termination is runtime-tested, Windows taskkill tree cleanup is implemented but requires native Windows certification.
provider_qualification.kg_boundary: Neo4j driver cleanup is explicit, but reviewed query-level deadline/cancellation evidence is incomplete; KG stage remains non-parallel.
provider_qualification.http_boundary: Default urllib Data-driven and OpenAI-compatible providers have bounded socket/provider timeouts and context cleanup, but no request-scoped hard cancellation; they remain non-parallel.
provider_qualification.model_boundary: Opaque/in-process model runtimes remain unqualified until CPU/GPU memory lifecycle, cancellation and crash containment are provider-specific certified.
provider_qualification.closure_rule: No additional generic Runtime refactor is required for these blocked provider qualifications; remaining work moves to concrete provider/platform qualification and real-device application validation.
provider_qualification.qualification_boundary: No G0-G4, diagnostic accuracy, flight, safety or cross-platform provider certification is promoted.

trusted_reference_contract_promotion.domain_boundary: ADAPT and PRONOSTIA providers remain domain/research scoped and are not core runtime dependencies.
trusted_reference_contract_promotion.qualification_boundary: Contract promotion does not change G0-G4, flight/safety, model performance or diagnosis accuracy claims.
trusted_reference_contract_promotion.evidence_policy: Historical application receipts are not bundled in the current-source delivery; contract/runtime code remains included.

research_paths.mission_agent: astrograph.agents.mission: host-approved task facade, no production-policy replacement

claim_boundary: The expanded campaign contains 132 acceptance-valid public cases across 66 modes and six research-only cases across three modes
Forty physical modes are uniquely identifiable; twenty-nine modes are reported only through seven frozen observational-equivalence classes
Formal evaluation reports 132/132 observation-class matches, 78/78 exact identifiable cases, and holdout 69/69 without public truth leakage

The S1 data-driven diagnosis baseline (shared-backbone MLP, 105-dim features, grouped holdout) is a RESEARCH PROBE, not a production capability. It is explicitly NOT bound to any production_path above (research_paths.production_binding=STABLE_MODEL_CONTRACT_REQUIRED_BEFORE_PROMOTION), is not reachable from unified/CLI, and all its numbers are 40-trace pipeline probes. Production binding would require the candidate-promotion freeze gate (DEV_GOAL) and resolution of the calibration-strategy decision (C2 exemption).
No arbitrary single-trace, open-set, multi-fault, cross-satellite, causal, flight, or safety qualification claim

spacecraft_scope_convergence.claim_boundary: Feature freeze/software stability does not promote development or seen-external evidence to independent external validation, HIL, safety or flight qualification.
